cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price on seat and movie selection
cases.description: Verify that clicking an available seat marks it as selected, updates data-testid="selected-count", and calculates data-testid="total-price" correctly based on the selected movie's price.

cases.title: Non-selectability of occupied seats and dynamic movie price updates
cases.description: Verify that clicking an occupied seat does not change the seat count or total price, and changing the selected movie updates the total price dynamically.

cases.title: Select Movie and Seat with LocalStorage Update
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from the dropdown updates the price, clicking an available seat toggles its selection, visually marks it, updates data-testid="selected-count" and data-testid="total-price", and stores the indices in localStorage.

cases.title: Deselect Seat and Exclude Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking a previously selected seat deselects it, updating the UI and localStorage accordingly, and that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in calculations.

cases.title: Restore State from LocalStorage on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the system retrieves 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' from local storage, marks the corresponding seats with the 'selected' class, and sets the movie dropdown to the correct option.

cases.title: Default State when LocalStorage is Empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the movie dropdown defaults to the first option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price upon seat selection and deselection
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats updates the selected-count and total-price correctly, and deselecting seats decreases these values accordingly.

cases.title: Recalculate total price and prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie selection updates the total price based on the new ticket price while preserving the selected seat count, and ensure occupied seats cannot be selected.

cases.title: Display seat status legends correctly
cases.description: Verify that legends indicating available, selected, and occupied seats are present on the Movie Seat Booking page with the correct identifiers such as data-testid = 'seat-select'.

cases.title: Occupied seats remain non-interactive via legends and grid
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied are non-interactive and clearly distinguished from available and selected seats to prevent selection.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are clear, distinct, cover the requirements thoroughly, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All test cases align properly with the requirements and provide clear verification steps without blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1: Normal scenario: Selecting an available seat and choosing a movie updates selected-count and total-price. Edge/Boundary scenario: Clicking an occupied seat does not change count or price. Abnormal scenario: Changing movie updates total price dynamically based on current selected seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2: Normal scenario: Selecting specific movies ('The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', 'No Country for Old Men ($9)') updates price and storing indices in localStorage. Edge/Boundary scenario: Deselecting a previously selected seat updates UI and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Normal scenario: Page load retrieves 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' from localStorage and restores UI state. Edge/Boundary scenario: Missing localStorage keys defaults dropdown to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)' and no selected seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4: Normal scenario: Toggling seat selection updates data-testid="selected-count" and data-testid="total-price". Edge/Boundary scenario: Changing movie selection with pre-selected seats recalculates total price with new ticket price. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Normal scenario: Legends display seat states (available, selected, occupied) with data-testid='seat-select'. Edge/Boundary scenario: Occupied seats remain non-interactive during clicks.
